mapper.select: select id, device_id, order_no, protocol, question, result_json, created_by, created_at from pep_domain.trouble_case order by id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into pep_domain.trouble_case (device_id, order_no, protocol, question, result_json, created_by, created_at) values (#{deviceId}, #{orderNo}, #{protocol}, #{question}, #{resultJson}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
